title: Webhooks
subtitle: Outbound HTTP notifications about events in your workspace.
noWebhooksDescription: Add a webhook to send HTTP notifications when events occur.
failuresSinceSuccess_one: 1 failed delivery since the last successful one.
failuresSinceSuccess_other: {{count}} failed deliveries since the last successful one.

form.secretMasked: Secret is set (leave blank to keep, or enter new value)
form.urlHint: Must be reachable from the internet. Private and local addresses are rejected unless the operator of this installation allows them.
form.insecureUrlWarning: Without HTTPS the payload travels in clear text, readable by anything on the way.
form.noSecretWarning: Without a secret the receiver cannot tell your payloads from anyone else's.
form.eventsNeedModulesGroup: Events of modules this organization has not enabled
form.withdrawnEventsHint: These names left the event catalogue, so they can never fire. Uncheck them and save to remove the subscription.

delivery.title: Delivery logs
delivery.abandonedByApp: Abandoned by Inventari — the target never answered

abandon.circuitBreaker: The circuit breaker cut this endpoint off after repeated failures.
abandon.webhookDisabled: The endpoint was switched off by an administrator.
abandon.moduleDisabled: The webhooks module is switched off for this organization.

testResult.successStillOff: Test ping passed ({{status}}), but this webhook is still off. Reactivate it to resume deliveries.
testResult.rejected: Test ping failed: the receiver answered {{status}}. The full response is in the delivery log.

confirmDeleteDescription: This will permanently delete the webhook and all its delivery logs.
circuitBreakerWarning_one: This webhook was auto-disabled after 1 consecutive failure — the cause of the last attempt is named in the delivery log.
circuitBreakerWarning_other: This webhook was auto-disabled after {{count}} consecutive failures — the cause of the last attempt is named in the delivery log.
eventsWhileOff: Events that happen while it is off are not delivered, queued or logged, and Reactivate does not replay them.

settings.logRetentionDaysDescription: How long to keep webhook delivery logs.
settings.circuitBreakerThresholdDescription: Auto-disable a webhook after this many consecutive failed attempts. Every attempt counts on its own — the first delivery, each retry and the Test button all feed the same tally.
